shortDescription: The only range designed to reach temperatures of 750°F+, the high-heat needed to create authentic restaurant-quality pizzas, in as little as 2 minutes - right in your oven. Start cooking fresh pizzas immediately - the range comes with the Stone-Baked Pizza Shield, 15" x 15" Stone and Peel.

features.text: 15+ Ways to Cook with Total Convection
Enjoy over 15+ ways to cook, like Air Fry, No Preheat, Slow Cook, Convection Bake, Steam Bake, Convection Roast, Steam Roast, Air Sous Vide, Bread Proof, Dehydrate and now Stone-Baked Pizza!
Five Element Cooktop
This cooktop has five elements designed to handle all of your cooking needs, including the powerful 3,200 Watt EvenTemp™ element for faster cooking.
No Preheat
Eliminates time wasted waiting for your oven to heat up - simply place your food in the cold oven and get to mealtime, in no time.
Air Fry
Air Fry allows you to make healthier and delicious meals for the entire family, right in your oven.
Slow Cook
Foods cooks slowly and at a lower temperature (as low as 100° F), allowing you to lock in moisture and flavor without over or undercooking your food.
Temperature Probe
The Temperature Probe monitors and alerts when the desired finished cooking temperature has been reached.
Store-More® Storage Drawer
The redesigned Store-More® Storage drawer is now even wider - allowing you to store your Stone-Baked Pizza Shield and Stone.
EvenTemp™ Cooktop Element
With the EvenTemp™ cooktop technology, heat is evenly distributed across the element's surface, which reduces hot spots and cold areas in your pan.
Steam and Self-Cleaning Options
Enjoy more cleaning flexibility. Select Steam Clean for a quick, 30-minute clean or choose Self Clean, which is available in 2, 3 and 4-hour cycles.
Air Sous Vide
Get the benefits of sous vide cooking, right in your oven. Air Sous Vide uses precisely controlled temperature and airflow to lock in flavor and moisture.
Steam Bake
With Steam Bake, steam evenly circulates throughout the oven cavity, resulting in breads and muffins that rise higher and are light and fluffy.
Steam Roast
Steam Roast uses moisture to make perfectly crispy and tender meats and vegetables that are roasted to perfection.
Premium Touch Screen Control Panel
Features a responsive 4.3-inch, full color, capacitive touch digital control panel.
Extra Large Oven Capacity
Cook more at once with a 6.2 cu. ft. capacity oven.
Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel
Resists fingerprints and cleans easily.
Frigidaire® Fit Promise

We promise that your new 30" Frigidaire front control range will fit your existing range cutout of the same width and configuration, or we will reimburse you up to one hundred dollars for professionally modifying the countertop.
